sourcePost.observedText:
Instead of asking people why they are single, ask them these questions instead:
~ Do you need some money?
~ Should I take you on a vacation?
~ Should I help you get a scholarship?
~ Should I buy you lunch?
~ Should I restock your skincare?
~ What’s bothering you at the moment?
You’re welcome.
